components.name: The Sheet
components.description: Signature structural device: the entire Market-through-Sources page body is one continuous bordered sheet, ruled into rows and column-groups by hairlines instead of a grid of separately-bordered cards.

components.css: .ds-sheet { border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e7e0d0; background: #fbf8ef; } .ds-row { padding: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e0d0; } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

components.name: Figure
components.description: Signature numeral component: every rate/score/percentage renders in Spectral with tabular figures via this one span; a null value renders a greyed em dash held in its column, never blank space.
components.css: .ds-figure { font-family: Spectral, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figure--held { color: #a8a29e; }

components.name: Status Light
components.description: Small lit dot preceding a row or section title, marking category/liveness. Replaces a colored top-border card-accent convention.
components.css: .ds-row-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-status-light { display: inline-block; height: 8px; width: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; color: #9c6b24; margin-right: 8px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Flat outlined classification label, not a soft-filled pill. Tone color shared by border and text.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-status-tag--emerald { border-color: rgba(5,150,105,0.5); color: #047857; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Theme toggle and similar icon-only controls: bordered, transparent, hover shifts to brass accent, icon settles via toggle-settle keyframes on theme change.

narrative.overview: The dashboard reads as a daily almanac page -- a fixed table of precisely computed figures a navigator would trust their position to -- not a SaaS card grid and not the prior instrument-panel register. The whole page body from Market through Sources is one continuous bordered sheet (app/page.tsx), ruled into rows and divide-x column-groups by hairlines instead of separately-bordered cards. Every numeral renders through components/Figure.tsx in Spectral with true tabular figures, wired through the existing font-mono utility -- the direct fix for the prior seven-segment digits the user rejected as hard to read. A missing/stale value is a greyed em dash held in its column, never blank space. The palette moved from cool slate/teal to warm stone/brass; the masthead band alone stays fixed near-black regardless of theme, carrying over the prior system's non-switching casing behavior.
keyCharacteristics: The page body is one continuous bordered sheet, ruled into rows and column-groups by hairlines, never a grid of separately-bordered cards.
Every numeral renders through Figure.tsx in Spectral with tabular figures; a missing/stale value is a greyed em dash held in its column, never blank.
Row/section membership is marked by a StatusLight dot beside the row's own h2, never a colored top-border stripe.
Brass is the one structural/decorative accent, never reused for status meaning; status colors never reused as brand/structural color.
The masthead band stays fixed near-black regardless of page theme; only the page chrome around it switches.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only non-functional color on the page. If a new element needs emphasis and it isn't conveying bullish/bearish/warning/neutral, it gets brass or it gets nothing.

rules.name: The Held-Value Rule
rules.body: A missing or stale numeric value never renders as blank space or omitted markup -- Figure.tsx renders a greyed em dash held in its column, so the ruled layout never shifts.

rules.name: The Dot-Not-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Row/section category membership is marked by a StatusLight dot beside the h2, never by a colored top-border or side-border stripe.

rules.name: The One-Numeral-Component Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value on the page renders through Figure.tsx in Spectral with tabular figures, never as raw typeset text in Inter.

rules.name: The Flush-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: No row or nested tile within the sheet has a shadow or a top-border accent stripe. Row identity comes from the StatusLight dot; apparent elevation comes from a surface-color step, never box-shadow.

dos: Do keep the entire Market-through-Sources body as one continuous bordered sheet, ruled into rows/column-groups by hairlines.
Do render every numeric value through Figure.tsx in Spectral with tabular figures.
Do render a missing/stale value as a greyed em dash held in its column, never blank or omitted markup.
Do mark row/section category with a StatusLight dot beside the h2, never a colored top-border stripe.
Do keep the masthead band fixed regardless of theme toggle, and reserve SectionLabel for rows that group multiple distinct blocks.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to a row or nested tile within the sheet.
Don't add a colored top-border or side-border accent stripe to a row -- use StatusLight instead.
Don't introduce a second brand accent hue alongside brass, or reuse a status color as a structural/brand color.
Don't add a SectionLabel above a single-block row (duplicates its own heading -- a banned kicker/eyebrow pattern), or fall back to a seven-segment/glyph-icon instrument display for a numeric readout.
